items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I see. How are we doing for time, Mary?

ctx.x: Composers Orchestra Guild. And they got a distributor thing going on and they would distribute our records if we made them and get them to them. It was LPs at that time. And they would distribute it for us, and they had a pretty good, wide range of distributing, and they would get them all over America to different record companies and so we sort of got a little bit of play behind that. And got a little independent too as well. So we sort of got jobs, you know. They started reaching out and getting us on some of…
I see. How are we doing for time, Mary? Eight minutes? You know it feels really good to be able to say President Obama these days.
